mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 10.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to safety and a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp over 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days in > 50% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 95.0 (index 2017=100) over two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases recession risk and triggers negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 95.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 255.0 (index 1982-1984=100) combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 255.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 0.05, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 480,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts, indicates strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in > 65% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 jobs per month, combined with a rising unemployment rate, signals labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending and corporate confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases where PAYEMS < 50000 and UNRATE > 10.0, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 18,900 billion dollars, observed over a 6-month window, indicates a recessionary economic environment, which triggers risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 < 18900, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
